Name: Fresh and Bit - New Recipes
Author: Minothilos
Description:
Fresh and Bit is a collection of 12 recipes, one for each of the bachelors and bachelorettes of Stardew Valley. They are sent to you in the mail after sufficient friendship is reached. The mod includes custom Gift Preferences for the cooked items and unique dialogue when gifted to specific characters. 

The recipes uses ingridients from Cornucopia - More Crops and Cornucopia - Artisan Machines. All modules of Cornucopia - More crops are required. If some of them are disabled the items will still show up but won't be obtainable.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/0cO9CVO.png[/img]
How to Learn:[spoiler]
Moules à la Crème: Haley 5 Hearts
Stuffed Bell Pepper: Penny 5 Hearts
Stuffed Pumpkin: Abigail 5 Hearts
Triple Threat Chilli: Sam 7 Hearts
Baked Lobster: Elliott 5 Hearts
Spinach Soup: Alex 5 Hearts
Lasagne: Harvey 7 Hearts
Empanada: Shane 7 Hearts
Beet Salad: Leah 5 Hearts
Onigiri: Sebastian 5 Hearts
Avocado Toast: Emily 7 Hearts

Recipes that require year 2 ingridients are typically given later.
[/spoiler]
